name: Benafer (Spain)
description: Blue field with a red triangle issuing from the hoist bearing a white orb banded and crossed yellow, the blue charged with four yellow fleurs-de-lis.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 5 April 2001 of the conseller de Justícia i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana; it is a flag of 2:3, enté at the hoist in red with a silver orb banded and crossed gold, the attribute of Saint Saviour, patron of the village, and blue with four gold fleurs-de-lis, the arms of Ènnec de Vallterra, bishop of Segorbe, who bought the Muslim farmstead of Benafer in 1379.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
orb (mound) banded and crossed yellow, attribute of Saint Saviour
four fleurs-de-lis, the arms of bishop Ènnec de Vallterra
